name: popover
title: Popover
description: A native popover anchored to its trigger with CSS anchor positioning: flips when it would not fit and unfolds from the side it opened on. CSS-only motion.

.rx-popover.transition: display var(--_exit) allow-discrete, overlay var(--_exit) allow-discrete

.rx-popover-surface.--_from: inset( calc(var(--_oy) * 0.86) calc((100% - var(--_ox)) * 0.86) calc((100% - var(--_oy)) * 0.86) calc(var(--_ox) * 0.86) round var(--radius-box) )
.rx-popover-surface.transition: opacity var(--_exit) var(--motion-ease), scale var(--_exit) var(--motion-ease), clip-path var(--_exit) var(--motion-ease)
